source_title: ‘Tracker’ Season 4 Release Schedule: When to Watch New Episodes - CNET
source_excerpt:
Tracker , CBS’s hit survivalist drama, is back for its fourth season. The show, which stars Justin Hartley as a tracker named Colter Shaw who travels the country finding missing people and fighting crime, ended its third season in May.
It’s October, and new episodes are here. When talking about Tracker, I must point out that there aren’t many shows around nowadays that can pull off such a tight turnaround, aside from Marshals , which airs the same night. So let’s all rejoice that more Tracker adventures are here.
Joining Hartley in the new episodes of Tracker are returning cast members Fiona Rene, Chris Lee and Cassady McClincy Zhang. Supernatural and The Boys alum Jensen Ackles will return as Colter’s brother, Russell.
Read on for more information on how to stream Season 4 of Tracker.

Tracker Season 4: When to watch the premiere episode
The fifth episode of Season 4 of Tracker, titled Need to Know, airs Sunday, Nov. 1, on CBS.
Tracker Season 4, episode 4, Purification synopsis: “fter a military contractor’s wife and daughter are kidnapped, Colter discovers Russell is investigating a related lead. The Shaw brothers join forces to uncover a high-stakes cover-up.” The episode will air live on Sunday, Nov. 1, at 9:30 p.m. ET/PT on CBS .
If you’d prefer to watch on Paramount Plus , access to the series depends on your subscription plan. Paramount Plus Premium (which costs $14 a month) includes your local CBS station, which means you’ll be able to watch the episode live. With the Paramount Plus Essential plan (which costs $9 a month), you won’t be able to check out the episode live, but it’ll be available on demand the following day.
Tracker Season 4 episode release schedule:
Episode 1: “Safe Harbor” — Sunday, Oct. 4, 2026
Episode 2: “Switchback” — Sunday, Oct. 11, 2026
Episode 3: “Original Parts” — Sunday, Oct. 18, 2026
Episode 4: “Purification” — Sunday, Oct. 25, 2026
Episode 5: “Need to Know” — Sunday, Nov. 1, 2026
Episode 6: “Blind Spot” — Sunday, Nov. 15, 2026
[ Note: CBS has not released any further episode info for Season 4 yet. That said, if the new run of episodes follows previous seasons, the show will take a holiday break around December and return in early 2027.]
You can also watch CBS and the premiere of Tracker, Season 4, without cable. You’ll need to subscribe to a live TV streaming service like YouTube TV , Hulu Plus Live TV or the DirecTV MyNews skinny bundle .
